errors.evidence: The phrase "Най-високият сегмент" (The highest segment) is ambiguous. It could refer to the segment with the largest percentage value or the segment that is physically at the top of the stacked bar. A clearer phrasing would be "Сегментът с най-голям дял" (The segment with the largest share).

The description incorrectly attributes the value of 28.6% to "отопление от централен източник" (heating from a central source) in the "Общо" category. According to the chart, 28.6% is the value for "Електричество" (Electricity), while "отопление от централен източник" is 16.4%.

errors.text_span: В стълба за "Градове" най-високият сегмент е отново на дървата – 38.3%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that for the "Градове" (Cities) category, the largest segment is for "дървата" (wood) with a value of 38.3%. The chart shows that 38.3% is the value for "Електричество" (Electricity), which is the largest segment. The value for "дървата" is 22.8%.
The description states that the share of gas for the "Общо" (Total) category is 0.2%. The chart clearly labels this value as 0.7%.
The description states that the share of gas for the "Градове" (Cities) category is 0.7%. The chart clearly labels this value as 0.9%.
